# McDonald's Buddy (McQuartet)

A four mode McDonald's China companion (McQuartet). Practice record turns your order history, points, coupons and prizes into achievements, streaks and a rank with a progress bar. Group meal commander collects each person's name, budget, wants and avoids, resolves a store, prices the real menu through calculate-price, matches one meal per person taste first and budget second, then merges everything into one shared order with a per person split and coupon advice: it plans and prices the group order, it does not place it. Hidden menu lab rebuilds a combo round by round against a goal (cut fat, build muscle, indulge, wake up) using the official nutrition table, with the full combo price recomputed by calculate-price. Daily fortune draws a date seeded fortune from the nutrition list, the campaign calendar and the lottery information, without ever drawing the lottery itself. The skill is read only by design: it never calls create-order, draw-lottery or mall-create-order, and leaves any money or points action to you in the official app.
